issues.concern: The main gloss 'crown, wreath' is misleading because 'wreath' is only covered by specific compounds (月桂冠), not by the headword 冠 alone. The headword primarily means 'crown' (royal or top of head) or 'radical'.
The tag 'general' is too broad and doesn't reflect the specific meanings of 'crown' (royal, body part) or 'radical'.
